critique: The ISO render reads cleanly and quickly as an FPGA NTT card: eight blue interleaved BRAM banks line the −X edge, the copper DSP-multiplier column and the symmetric add/sub pairs sit in an open framed array, the exploded radix-4 BU and ten-fin heatsink lift cleanly off the die, and FRONT/SIDE show no parts sunk below or floating above the ground line. Form is mature; the binding deficit remains reproduction-faithfulness, not silhouette. The one residual geometry defect the previous pass flagged is real: bu_add_0 (z=−4.09, outer face −4.30) and bu_sub_7 (z=+4.09, outer face +4.30) overhang the array floor's z=±4.2 edge by ~0.1 m — fixed this pass by widening the open frame to contain them rather than nudging the operators into interpenetration. The deep faithfulness gaps (the paper's exact conflict-free bank/offset functions, crossbar permutation σ_s, twiddle-ROM addressing, DIT/DIF convention, radix-4 fusion mapping and per-stage cycle counts) are honestly flagged in the specs as reproduction candidates and require the CFNTT source PDF, which is not available in this non-interactive pass.
